methods_quotes.q: Outbreak duration was calculated as the number of days between the symptom onset date of the index case and the last case in the outbreak
Demographic characteristics of patients and the proportion of patients isolated and treated in an ETU or similar facility were summarized by outbreak.
The first generation of cases was defined as resulting from contact with the index patient
An Ebola outbreak was defined as two or more epidemiologically linked Ebola cases.
